module fsm (
    input clk, reset, in,
    output reg done,
    output reg [7:0] state
);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            done <= 0;
            state <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                0: if (in[3]) begin state <= 1; done <= 0; end
                1: if (in[3]) begin state <= 2; done <= 0; end else state <= 0;
                2: begin state <= 0; done <= 1; end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
